name: smwgraphics-mickey-mania-snes-lonesome-ghosts-basement
title: Mickey Mania (SNES) - Lonesome Ghosts (Basement)
description:
Been a while since I ripped and released a rip.

The red line separates the two pages.

TIP: xB1, xE3, xE4, xF3, and xF4 (where x is the page number of your choice) should be inserted as
teleport blocks via Blocktool.

NOTE: This can be inserted via 1.90 or higher only.

No credit needed.

Major update: Added the sample level in a complete state and also added .pal and .palmask files. I also cleaned the GFX so that most can be easily spotted for view.
I also added tiles 1B05 & 1B06 representing the platform.
My version also saves 4 tiles.
I did improvise a bit.

No credit needed.
